name: Searching
when: Looking through reports, data or the web

variants.name: Scan list
variants.desc: Holds up a page and runs a magnifier along each line.

variants.name: Flashlight
variants.desc: Sweeps a flashlight beam up and down, eyes following it.

variants.name: Sonar
variants.desc: Sends out sonar rings until a blip pops up and catches its eye.

variants.name: Peek around
variants.desc: Leans way out to one side, then the other, looking around.

variants.name: Sniff
variants.desc: Squints and sniffs along a scent trail like a bloodhound.
